title: The weavers
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Eduyot ch. 1, mishnah 3: they testified in the name of Shemaya and Avtalyon, and the Sages accepted their words over the words of Shammai and Hillel.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Torat Emet Mishnah Eduyot 1:3 scalar reports two weavers testifying in the name of Shemaya and Avtalyon, after the differing positions of Hillel and Shammai, and the sages upholding their testimony. Hyman’s comparison is retained without importing the quantities or legal ruling into this entry.
